treatment.request: An animated README cover for LitHermes where the name itself moves.
treatment.idea: A weight swell rolls diagonally through rows of drifting letters and through the still hero name.
treatment.recipeReason: The name is the material: its weight moves and its position never does.

motto.from: the motto painted on the repository artwork

layers.slow: Rows of the word drift one word length per loop, alternate rows the other way.
layers.mid: The weight tide sweeps the screen once per loop.
layers.beat: A cursor steps under each hero letter and runs home on the last stop.

system.rule: Weight is a gained swell of the loop phase.
system.copies: About six hundred background letters and the nine hero letters.
system.offset: Each letter's screen position, 0.85 x plus 0.35 y.

treatment.ambition: Every letter on screen moves and the hero never thins below a readable weight.
